notes: v1.14.466 - Legacy mode opt-in now uses sessionStorage instead of localStorage. BUGFIX: ?legacy=1 was persisting indefinitely, trapping operators in the old shell even on clean URLs. New behavior: ?legacy=1 works as a session-scoped rip-cord (survives tab reload) but clears when the tab closes, allowing new sessions to boot the current shell. Operators who need legacy mode can re-opt-in with ?legacy=1 per session. No data loss, behavior preserved.
